methods.name: make_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script in the destination binary directory that sets Go environment variables and invokes the actual Go binary.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Preparation for configuration, in this case, no operation; likely inherited build step.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Sets environment variables for cross-compilation and runs the build script 'make.bash' inside the source directory.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled Go package, copies necessary directories, removes testdata, and creates wrapper scripts for binaries.

calls: (cd ${S}/src; for d in *; do [ ! -d $d ] || cp --preserve=mode,timestamps -R ${S}/src/$d ${D}${libdir}/go/src/; done)
for f in ${B}/bin/*; do base=`basename $f`; install -m755 $f ${D}${libdir}/go/bin; make_wrapper $base ${TARGET_PREFIX}$base; done
